title: Condition
wikitext:
'''Condition''' cards are a type of [[Special]] card, introduced in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.  At present only [[Dunwich Horror]] includes conditions.

Conditions represent some type of long-lasting change to the conditions of the game (like a [[Mythos#Environment|Mythos Environment]] card) which the investigators can put into permanent effect through  their actions in combination with other game events.  

Usually the condition's effect is advantageous to the investigators.

==List of Conditions==

* [[Coded Messages]]
* [[Darke's Blessing]]
* [[Rare Book Collection]]
* [[Velma's Gratitude]]
